summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions, Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing a 4-to-1 share combination approved by its board. The combination reduces outstanding Class A shares from 13,079,201 to approximately 3,269,801, effective May 18, 2026, with fractional shares rounding up. No shareholder vote is required under BVI law. This reverse stock split is intended to maintain Nasdaq listing compliance, not a capital return or restructuring event. There are no deal terms or risk-arb angles; the filing is a routine Nasdaq compliance measure.
